Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly identify the nature of the query and the status of the series. The user asked for the "next episode" of the series featuring "Steven the Sword Fighter." The Planner immediately assumed this referred to a future release date for the *Steven Universe* franchise, ignoring the fact that "Steven the Sword Fighter" is a specific episode title (S01E16) and the series has already concluded. Instead of searching for the *next episode in the chronological order* (which would be "Gem Hunt"), the Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to search for "next episode release date," leading to a cycle of searching for non-existent future air dates rather than identifying the subsequent episode in the existing list. This is a fundamental failure in task interpretation and search strategy formulation.
